meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，Codex 成功执行编辑类操作（如 apply_patch、write、edit 等）后会自动运行评论检查；检查器报警告时，Codex 会先修复或解释被标记的评论，再继续。
howto.when: 成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作后触发；检查器报警告时，Codex 会收到阻塞反馈。

say.text: 修复补丁中被 comment-checker 标记的评论。
say.note: Codex 会先处理警告再继续。

say.text: 解释一下这条注释为什么需要保留。
say.note: Codex 会向检查器说明理由。

say.text: 有评论警告就先处理，再继续任务。
say.note: Codex 会按反馈修复或解释。

howto.what_en: After installation, Codex automatically runs the comment checker after successful edit operations (e.g., apply_patch, write, edit). If it reports a warning, Codex must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing.
howto.when_en: Triggered after successful calls to edit tools such as apply_patch, write, edit, etc. When the checker reports a warning, Codex receives blocking feedback and handles it before proceeding.

say_en.text: Fix the comment flagged by the comment-checker in the patch.
say_en.note: Codex will address the warning first.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment should stay.
say_en.note: Codex will justify it to the checker.

say_en.text: Handle any comment warnings before continuing.
say_en.note: Codex will fix or explain as needed.
